n3b8f3d272c.headline: China battles to shore up stocks, yuan after globe-shaking slide
n3b8f3d272c.summary: China took measures to support its stock markets and yuan currency following a significant slide that rattled global markets, with stocks falling over 2% in early trade.
n3b8f3d272c.why: China's stock market and currency movements have major global economic implications due to China's role as the world's second-largest economy and a key driver of global trade and investment.
n3b8f3d272c.why_moved: The sharp declines in China's stock market and yuan prompted government intervention to stabilize markets and prevent contagion effects globally.

n149b4094f7.headline: Internet celebrity economics: The beauty economy worth hundreds of millions
n149b4094f7.summary: Mainland China's internet celebrities, often ordinary people with high appearance value, have built fan bases that convert into purchasing power worth tens to hundreds of millions.
n149b4094f7.why: The internet celebrity economy drives significant consumer spending and marketing innovation in China's digital commerce sector.
